description: This Java source file defines the MakeValue class, which implements an entity operation for the OFBiz Minilang framework. It processes the <make-value> element, creating a new entity value and assigning it to a specified variable in the method context.

classes.name: MakeValue
classes.description: Implements an entity operation to create and assign a new entity value based on the <make-value> element in the MiniLang framework.

methods.name: MakeValue(Element element, SimpleMethod simpleMethod)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MakeValue instance with element attributes and validated values.

methods.name: exec(MethodContext methodContext)
methods.description: Executes the operation: creates a valid entity value and assigns it to the environment variable.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo(ArtifactInfoContext aic)
methods.description: Collects artifact information, notably the entity name.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MakeValue element configuration.
